name: gigsync
description: GigSync: a gig worker's own agent on her phone. It agrees the job, holds back her contact until both sides sign, and keeps the signed record.

scripts.lint: biome check . && node scripts/check-file-size.mjs && node scripts/check-magic-strings.mjs
scripts.build:workers: pnpm --filter @gigsync/worker-api exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist && pnpm --filter @gigsync/worker-index exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.i18n:sheet: pnpm --filter @gigsync/core build && node scripts/i18n-sheet.mjs && biome format --write docs/gigsync/i18n-review.md
scripts.reader:train: node scripts/reader-data/works.mjs --out data/reader/v1 && cd training/reader && uv run train.py --data ../../data/reader/v1 --out ../../data/reader/model-v1 && uv run export.py --model ../../data/reader/model-v1 --data ../../data/reader/v1
